evaluations.note: Named Hugging Face model plus an explicit scheme and output path.
evaluations.prompt: Use AMD Quark to quantize Qwen/Qwen3-8B to FP8 and save the Hugging Face model under ./artifacts/qwen3-fp8. Show me the plan before doing expensive work.
expected_behavior: Begins with read-only model intake, presents model_analysis.json, and waits for confirmation before planning or executing quantization.
unexpected_behavior: Runs the generated quark-cli quantization command, downloads model weights, creates the output directory, or starts PTQ before the user explicitly approves that exact command.

evaluations.prompt: I have the Hugging Face model mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1. Help me choose an AMD Quark quantization scheme and take it through PTQ to a quantized safetensors output.
Quantize the local PyTorch LLM at /models/my-llama-safetensors with Quark INT4 weight-only PTQ, preserving the model-specific exclusions and writing the result to /models/quantized/my-llama.
expected_behavior: Resolves the local model path and verifies that the directory and config.json exist before reading model metadata or planning quantization.
If the model path is unavailable, reports the exact missing input and stops at intake without inventing model facts or creating the output directory.
unexpected_behavior: Loads model weights, creates the output directory, chooses exclusions, or builds an execution command before the model intake is valid and confirmed.
